title: Playtest checklist
summary: M0 proves the toolchain works on your PC: a grey test yard with the axis canary markers on a slow turntable.
tryThis: Double-click Play.bat. A window opens on a grey test yard with three small coloured cubes turning slowly.
Press F10. The playtest checklist opens on the right. Answer both questions; your answers save as you go.
Press F10 again to close it, then close the window.
knownIssues: There is nothing to drive yet. Millbrook arrives in M1.
